On a fall day, my wife and I went boating on the Blackfoot River. I was excited about the trip because it would allow me to forget my [41].
At noon, we rested on a bank. [42] the scenery, we barely realized the approaching danger. Then three large [43] emerged from the forest: a huge mama bear with two babies. They were less than 100 feet away across the river, far closer than the recommended [44] distance.
I could feel [45] reached deep into my stomach. Time stood still. Then, I grabbed the bear spray (喷雾) and we walked downriver to [46] ourselves. “Hey, bears!” I said. “We are not here to [47] you.” At that moment, I thought the mama bear would [48] across the river, covering the 100 feet in seconds. Although I knew how to use the spray, I didn't think I could use it [49].
To our surprise, the mama bear [50] drank water from the river. When one baby wandered just a few steps away, she quickly [51] him. Just like their [52] appearance, they were gone, disappearing into the forest. We returned to our boat, lost in [53].
This encounter [54] me, making my daily concerns insignificant in the larger context of our planet. The experience, the fear, and my [55] as a human have changed my perspective on the world forever.

questions.explanation: 根据最后一段中的“making my daily concerns insignificant”可知，作者去划船是为了忘记日常的“担忧/烦恼”(concerns)。
questions.supplement:
A(concerns): 语境句：She forgot her daily concerns when she was on holiday. 固定搭配：daily concerns, public concerns
B(principles): 语境句：He refused to compromise his moral principles. 固定搭配：stick to principles, basic principles
C(passions): 语境句：He has a deep passion for literature. 固定搭配：have a passion for, follow your passion
D(secrets): 语境句：They shared their deepest secrets with each other. 固定搭配：keep a secret, top secret

questions.explanation: 空格处表示原因，正是因为作者和妻子“沉浸于(Absorbed in)”美丽的风景中，才几乎没有意识到危险的逼近。Tired of意为厌倦；Looking into意为调查；Reflecting on意为反思，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(Tired of): 语境句：He grew tired of the repetitive daily routine. 固定搭配：be tired of, get tired of
B(Absorbed in): 语境句：Absorbed in the fascinating book, she didn't hear the knock. 固定搭配：be absorbed in, completely absorbed in
C(Looking into): 语境句：The police are looking into the cause of the fire. 固定搭配：look into a case, look into a matter
D(Reflecting on): 语境句：Reflecting on his past mistakes, he decided to change. 固定搭配：reflect on oneself, reflect on the past

questions.explanation: 结合冒号后的解释“a huge mama bear with two babies”可知，刚开始他们只是从树林中看到了三个巨大的“模糊轮廓/身影(shapes)”。
questions.supplement:
A(signs): 语境句：There are no obvious signs of improvement in the economy. 固定搭配：signs of life, warning signs
B(pictures): 语境句：He took many beautiful pictures during his trip. 固定搭配：take pictures, draw a picture
C(targets): 语境句：The company has set high sales targets for this year. 固定搭配：achieve a target, set a target
D(shapes): 语境句：We could barely make out the shapes of buildings in the fog. 固定搭配：in the shape of, take shape

questions.explanation: 他们离熊不到100英尺，这远近于推荐的“安全(safe)”距离。
questions.supplement:
A(social): 语境句：She is very active in local social events. 固定搭配：social media, social skills
B(safe): 语境句：It is important to keep a safe distance from wild animals. 固定搭配：safe distance, safe and sound
C(average): 语境句：The average temperature here is quite high in summer. 固定搭配：on average, above average
D(constant): 语境句：The machine requires a constant supply of electricity. 固定搭配：constant change, constant companion

questions.explanation: 面对距离极近的熊，危险逼近，且后文提到“The experience, the fear...”，可知作者感到深深的“恐惧(fear)”。易错点是选surprise，但面对猛兽袭来的直觉反应应为恐惧。
questions.supplement:
A(fear): 语境句：She overcame her fear of the dark eventually. 固定搭配：in fear, out of fear
B(surprise): 语境句：To our surprise, he won the first prize in the competition. 固定搭配：in surprise, to one's surprise
C(excitement): 语境句：The children jumped up and down in excitement. 固定搭配：in excitement, cause excitement
D(courage): 语境句：It takes great courage to admit one's mistakes. 固定搭配：have the courage to do, lose courage

questions.explanation: 作者抓起喷雾，顺流而下，是为了拉开自己和熊之间的“距离(distance)”。distance作动词，意为“疏远，与...拉开距离”。
questions.supplement:
A(relax): 语境句：Listening to soft music helps me relax after work. 固定搭配：relax oneself, relax the rules
B(corner): 语境句：The thief was finally cornered by the police in an alley. 固定搭配：around the corner, drive into a corner
C(dismiss): 语境句：The manager dismissed the idea as impractical. 固定搭配：dismiss a meeting, dismiss an idea
D(distance): 语境句：He tried to distance himself from the scandal. 固定搭配：distance oneself from, keep a distance

questions.explanation: 作者对熊喊话以示安抚：“我们不是来‘打扰(bother)’你们的”。tease意为取笑，不合猛兽语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bathe): 语境句：The doctor advised him to bathe the wound with warm water. 固定搭配：bathe in sunlight, take a bath
B(tease): 语境句：The boys used to tease him about his strange accent. 固定搭配：tease someone about, playfully tease
C(bother): 语境句：Please don't bother your father while he is working. 固定搭配：bother to do, bother someone with
D(pet): 语境句：She bent down to pet the cute little dog. 固定搭配：pet a dog, pet animals

questions.explanation: 由后半句“covering the 100 feet in seconds”可知，作者当时以为母熊会以极快的速度越过河“猛冲/冲锋(charge)”过来。charge在此指猛兽的突击冲锋。
questions.supplement:
A(sail): 语境句：The ship will sail for New York next week. 固定搭配：sail across, set sail
B(float): 语境句：The empty bottle floated on the surface of the water. 固定搭配：float away, float on water
C(charge): 语境句：The angry bull lowered its head and charged at the man. 固定搭配：charge at, in charge of
D(wander): 语境句：We spent the afternoon wandering around the old town. 固定搭配：wander around, wander aimlessly

questions.explanation: 因为母熊几秒钟就能跑完100英尺，所以作者认为即使会用喷雾，也没有时间“及时(in time)”使用它。
questions.supplement:
A(in advance): 语境句：You need to book the tickets in advance during holidays. 固定搭配：book in advance, pay in advance
B(at random): 语境句：The teacher chose a student at random to answer the question. 固定搭配：choose at random, pick at random
C(at peace): 语境句：After resolving the conflict, she finally felt at peace. 固定搭配：feel at peace, live at peace
D(in time): 语境句：Luckily, the firefighters arrived in time to put out the fire. 固定搭配：in time, just in time

questions.explanation: 令作者惊讶的是，母熊并没有发起攻击，而“仅仅是(simply)”在河里喝水。
questions.supplement:
A(probably): 语境句：He will probably be late because of the heavy traffic. 固定搭配：very probably, most probably
B(simply): 语境句：The solution to the problem is simply to communicate more. 固定搭配：simply put, simply ignore
C(naturally): 语境句：She is naturally talented in playing the piano. 固定搭配：act naturally, naturally gifted
D(certainly): 语境句：I will certainly attend your birthday party tonight. 固定搭配：almost certainly, certainly not

questions.explanation: 当一只小熊走远了几步，母熊很快把它“接回/找回(fetched)”。fetch意为“去取来，接回”。rescue(救援)程度太重，小熊仅仅是走远了几步。
questions.supplement:
A(rescued): 语境句：The firefighters rescued the child from the burning building. 固定搭配：rescue someone from, come to one's rescue
B(abandoned): 语境句：The broken car was abandoned by the side of the road. 固定搭配：abandon a plan, permanently abandoned
C(fetched): 语境句：The dog ran to fetch the stick thrown by its owner. 固定搭配：fetch water, fetch someone
D(examined): 语境句：The doctor examined the patient carefully. 固定搭配：examine closely, physically examine

questions.explanation: 熊的离开就像它们“出乎意料的(unexpected)”出现一样快。文中熊是突然从森林里出现的，完全出乎作者的意料。
questions.supplement:
A(timely): 语境句：The government provided timely assistance to the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：timely manner, timely help
B(inappropriate): 语境句：His casual clothes were inappropriate for such a formal occasion. 固定搭配：highly inappropriate, inappropriate behavior
C(unexpected): 语境句：The project was delayed due to an unexpected problem. 固定搭配：unexpected result, completely unexpected
D(regular): 语境句：Regular exercise is essential for maintaining good health. 固定搭配：on a regular basis, regular check-up

questions.explanation: 经历了自然和猛兽的震撼后，作者陷入了对大自然的“敬畏(awe)”之中。从最后一段中作者感到自身渺小并改变了世界观可知，不仅仅是震惊(shock)，更是一种敬畏之心。
questions.supplement:
A(awe): 语境句：The tourists stood in awe of the magnificent waterfall. 固定搭配：in awe of, an awe-inspiring sight
B(shock): 语境句：The news of his sudden resignation came as a shock to everyone. 固定搭配：in shock, a culture shock
C(regret): 语境句：To my great regret, I missed the opportunity to study abroad. 固定搭配：express regret, much to one's regret
D(calmness): 语境句：He handled the emergency with surprising calmness. 固定搭配：maintain calmness, inner calmness

questions.explanation: 这次偶遇让作者感到自身的渺小(humbled)。humble作动词表示“使感到谦卑、使感到自己微不足道”，与后文的“making my daily concerns insignificant”一致。
questions.supplement:
A(astonished): 语境句：We were astonished at the rapid progress he had made. 固定搭配：be astonished at, absolutely astonished
B(humbled): 语境句：The famous scientist was humbled by the vastness of the universe. 固定搭配：feel humbled, a humbling experience
C(refreshed): 语境句：After a good night's sleep, I woke up feeling completely refreshed. 固定搭配：feel refreshed, totally refreshed
D(fueled): 语境句：His success fueled her determination to work even harder. 固定搭配：fuel the fire, heavily fueled

questions.explanation: 在广阔的大自然面前，作者意识到了作为人类的“局限性(limitations)”，这彻底改变了他的世界观。
questions.supplement:
A(limitations): 语境句：We must recognize our own limitations and seek help when needed. 固定搭配：know one's limitations, overcome limitations
B(responsibilities): 语境句：Parents have many responsibilities towards their children. 固定搭配：take responsibilities, shoulder responsibilities
C(advantages): 语境句：Living in a big city has its own advantages and disadvantages. 固定搭配：take advantage of, an unfair advantage
D(virtues): 语境句：Patience and kindness are considered important virtues in many cultures. 固定搭配：a man of virtue, moral virtues

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the digital age, many young people tend to share marriage announcements on social media platforms like Sina Weibo. Yet a new trend has reemerged — publishing marriage announcements in traditional newspapers. [56] quick search on the topic “publishing marriage announcements in newspapers” will bring up [57] (variety) posts, along with those who have done so sharing their experiences.
[58] short-lived digital posts, newspaper announcements provide a sense of permanence, offering a meaningful way [59] (keep) memories during a time when digital content can't last. Some young people view publishing marriage announcements in newspapers as more formal than [60] in social media, and they describe it as a [61] (commit) written in black ink and on white paper — a declaration of the couple's promise to grow old together.
However, this practice is not a new phenomenon in China. In the first half of the twentieth century, when marriage laws were still underdeveloped, such announcements [62] (carry) legal significance. They allowed couples to [63] (public) share their joyous news with their family and friends.
The regained popularity serves as an example of [64] tradition can better adapt to modern times. By combining cultural heritage with personal creativity, it offers meaningful rituals (仪式) in today's digital world. These announcements, as symbols of love and individuality, remind us that some traditions are worth [65] (preserve).

questions.explanation: 句意：在相关话题上进行一次快速搜索…… a quick search 表示“一次快速搜索”，考查不定冠词泛指。首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(A)：语境句：A quick search on the internet will give you the answer. 固定搭配：a quick search, a wide variety of。原词无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词 posts，应使用形容词形式，variety 的形容词为 various，意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The school offers various activities for students after class. 固定搭配：various kinds of, for various reasons。原词variety其它变形：varied(adj.), vary(v.), variable(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：与短暂的数字帖子不同，报纸声明提供了一种永久感。根据句意对比关系可知填介词 Unlike (与……不同)，位于句首需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Unlike)：语境句：Unlike his brother, he is very shy and quiet. 固定搭配：quite unlike, entirely unlike。原词其它变形：like(prep./v.), likely(adj.), dislike(v.)。

questions.explanation: a way to do sth 为固定句型，表示“做某事的一种方式”，这里需用动词不定式作后置定语，修饰 way。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to keep)：语境句：Reading is a good way to keep your mind active. 固定搭配：a way to do sth, keep in mind。原词keep其它变形：kept(过去式/过去分词), keeper(n.), keeping(n.)。

questions.explanation: 此处比较的是“在报纸上发布结婚声明”和“在社交媒体上发布”，为了避免重复，用代词 that 替代单数/不可数概念的 publishing marriage announcements (即发声明这件事)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai. 固定搭配：that is to say, in that。原词其它变形：those(pl.)。

questions.explanation: 空前有不定冠词 a 修饰，此处应填入名词 commitment，意为“承诺”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(commitment)：语境句：Marriage is a lifelong commitment between two people. 固定搭配：make a commitment, a firm commitment。原词commit其它变形：committed(adj.), committee(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句中的时间状语 In the first half of the twentieth century 表明描述的是过去发生的事情，谓语动词需用一般过去时 carried，意为“具有（法律意义）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carried)：语境句：He carried the heavy box all the way to the top floor. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrying(现在分词), carrier(n.), carriage(n.)。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰动词 share，应使用副词形式 publicly，意为“公开地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(publicly)：语境句：The company publicly apologized for the poor quality of its products. 固定搭配：publicly announce, publicly available。原词public其它变形：publication(n.), publicize(v.), publicity(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：这种重新兴起的流行趋势是传统“如何”更好地适应现代社会的一个例子。介词 of 后跟宾语从句，句意缺“如何”，用 how 引导。
questions.supplement: 正确形(how)：语境句：He explained to us how the new machine works. 固定搭配：how to do, no matter how。原词其它变形：however(adv.)。

questions.explanation: be worth doing 为固定搭配，意为“值得被做”，此处用动名词的主动形式表示被动意义，故填 preserving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(preserving)：语境句：These ancient historical sites are definitely worth preserving. 固定搭配：be worth preserving, preserve the environment。原词preserve其它变形：preservation(n.), preserved(adj.), preservative(n.)。
